releaseTitle: ATalk v3.10.3 — Zero-Friction Keyboard Persistence & 100% Platform Integration
releaseNotes:
• 01 Zero-Friction Keyboard Persistence: Tapping on any message bubble or the top-right three-dot menu no longer dismisses the software keyboard. The Input Method Editor (IME) remains uninterrupted with full typing continuity.
• 02 Window Focus Architecture: Message context menu migrated to non-focusable window popup with dedicated BackHandler gestures and adaptive vertical scroll for compact viewports.
• 03 100% Design Platform Integration: Khroma AI neural color palettes & duotones, Haikei generative Delaunay triangulation & sine waves, Fffuel 3D isometric matrix & particle bursts, Huemint WCAG contrast compliance, and RealtimeColors 60-30-10 UI harmony.
• 04 AGSL Optical Refraction & Tactical Scanlines: Hardware-accelerated Snell's law chromatic dispersion and CRT phosphor scanlines.
• 05 Multi-Tier Sensory Haptics: Logarithmic overscroll stretch ticks, crisp context menu pop vibrations, and encryption seal confirmations.
